name: Serve MCP Tool Calls
description: Accept MCP tool calls (stdio or in-process transport) and dispatch them to the Aurora model tool implementation. Read-only calls consult the index/working set; write calls are confirmation-gated by the hosting UI policy, acquire the exclusive model lock, validate, apply transactionally, append one audit entry, and schedule asynchronous index updates. Every tool call returns machine-readable JSON with success/failure plus progress/cancellation where applicable.
